args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary (main + companion)
args.body:
• Temperature excursions fell 30% among carriers that shared live sensor data (Bellwether, 2026 cold-chain piece).
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than less spoilage.
• Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion
